warnings: This is a Zn fertilizer study, not CO2 study - the meta-analysis context appears mismatched
Multiple Zn sources tested: ZnSO4, Zn(Arg)2, Zn(Gly)2, Zn(His)2 - each should be treated as separate treatments vs control
Split-plot design with cultivars as subplots may create dependency in observations
Two years of data - need to extract year-specific values to avoid pseudoreplication
Control is 'no Zn fertilizer' (Ctrl) - clearly defined as zero-Zn treatment
Figure 3 shows grain Zn concentration data with error bars - this is the primary outcome

recon.control_definition: Control (Ctrl) - no Zn fertilizer was applied during the whole growth stage
recon.treatment_definition: Foliar applications of ZnSO4, Zn(Arg)2, Zn(Gly)2, and Zn(His)2 at 0.2% Zn (w/v)
recon.sample_size_source: The experimental design was a split plot in randomized complete block design with three replicates. Error bars represent standard error (n = 3)
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration data from Figure 3. Data is presented separately for two cultivars (Back Cross and Kavir) and two years (2009-2010, 2010-2011). Each Zn treatment (ZnSO4, Zn-Arg, Zn-Gly, Zn-His) should be compared against the Ctrl (no Zn) treatment. Extract year-specific and cultivar-specific values to avoid pseudoreplication. Standard errors are shown as error bars with n=3 replicates per treatment combination.
